key_hash.description: The SHA-256 of the station key, in lower-case hex. Never the key itself

idle_lines.description: What the station shows between taps, from its game. The GeekyKey Service gives them to the station in the heartbeat's answer. Left out for a station whose game gives none, such as one with no game. The GeekyKey Service leaves out any that break these rules, and the station keeps its own idle screen

items.description: One row of the station's 16x2 screen
